title: Learning VB.NET
author: Unknown
content: How did you learn to code VB.NET? I've been trying to improve my skill to write tailored Business Rules. Any resources/guide to share?
solution_text: If you're just getting started with Rule Writing in OneStream, make sure you download and install the Snippet Editor from MarketPlace. Recommended sites: learnvisualstudio.net, tutorialspoint.com/vb.net, functionx.com/vb.
